-
Chair Chaffee and Supervisor Wagner presented a resolution proclaiming August 2026 as "Eligibility Professionals Recognition Month"

1

2
Orange County Veterans Advisory Council - Reappoint John E. Burick, Mission Viejo, Michael Radigan, Newport Beach and Stephanie Wade, Seal Beach, for terms ending 8/24/28

3
Orange County Juvenile Justice Coordinating Council - Appoint Laura Marcum, Costa Mesa, for term ending 8/24/28

4
Orange County Waste Management Commission - Appoint Cameron Cosgrove, San Clemente, for term concurrent with 5th District Supervisor's term of office

5
Receive and file Quarterly Information Technology Projects Progress Report for Fourth Quarter FY 2025-26

6

7
Approve amendment 2 to Biometric Verification Services License with Alclear, LLC, term ending 9/23/28

8

10
Adopt resolution certifying completion of streets, street lights, sewer, water, storm drain and monumentation; accepting easement for street purposes of Williams Way and Sunrise Road; making related findings; and authorizing release of bond securities for Final Tract Map 19150

11
Adopt resolution certifying completion of streets, street lights, sewer, water, storm drain and monumentation; accepting easement of Sunrise Road; making related findings; and authorizing release of bond securities for Final Tract Map 19149

12
Approve non-financial Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) MA-063-26011648 with Olive Crest for commercially sexually exploited children support services, term ending 6/30/29; and authorize County Procurement Officer or Deputized designee to execute MOU

Approve amendment 3 to renew contract MA-060-23011646 with Computer Deductions Inc. for Unisys mainframe computer and Sheriff-Coroner Data Center operations, 11/1/26 - 10/31/27 ($500,000; cumulative total $2,615,832); renewable for one additional one-year term; and authorize County Procurement Officer or Deputized designee to execute amendment

15
Approve amendment 3 to contract MA-060-23011670 with All City Management Services Inc., for provision of crossing guard services, 11/1/26 - 10/31/27 ($1,418,182; cumulative total $4,967,125); renewable for one additional one-year term; and authorize County Procurement Officer or Deputized designee to execute amendment

16
Approve amendment 3 to renew contract MA-060-23010335 with Powers Bros. Machine, Inc. for sewage grinders maintenance service and to add Paragraph 33 Facility Sublease to General Terms and Conditions, 9/13/26 - 9/12/27 ($300,000; cumulative total $1,200,000); and authorize County Procurement Officer or Deputized designee to execute amendment

17
Approve FY 2025-26 Federal Equitable Sharing Agreement and Certification for federally forfeited property or proceeds received for Sheriff-Coroner Department

18
Approve new Ground Lease agreements with DPHP Hotels, LLC including Full Service Hotel Ground Lease and Select-Service Hotel Ground Lease for hotel component, with Dana Point Harbor Partners, LLC for commercial core and marina component, and with Dana Point Harbor Partners Drystack, LLC for drystack components of Dana Point Harbor Revitalization Project, 66-year terms; and authorize Chief Real Estate Officer or designee to execute lease agreements, amendments and related documents under certain conditions - District 5

19
Approve proposed response to FY 2025-26 Grand Jury Report "PFAS and Public Awareness: A Closer Look at Orange County Drinking Water"

20
Approve proposed response to FY 2025-26 Grand Jury Report "Growing Political Appointees and Discretionary Spending within the OC Board of Supervisors"

21
Approve proposed response to FY 2025-26 Grand Jury Report "Unbalanced Authority Oversight and Accountability in Orange County Government"

22
Approve grant applications/awards submitted by Health Care Agency, John Wayne Airport, OC Community Resources and Sheriff-Coroner and retroactive grant applications/awards submitted by OC Community Resources and Sheriff-Coroner in 8/25/26 grant report and other actions as recommended

23
Approve recommended positions on introduced or amended legislation and/or consider other legislative subject matters

32

($315,240; cumulative total $997,735) and amendment 2 to contract MA-080-26010368 with US Metro Group, Inc. Approve aggregate contract MA-080-26011093 with Savala Equipment Company Inc. and Top Hand Heavy Equipment Rental, LLC for heavy equipment rental with operator services, 10/17/26 - 10/16/29 (aggregate total $2,775,000); renewable for two additional years; and authorize County Procurement Officer or Deputized designee to execute contract

Approve amendment 2 to renew contract MA-299-23011468 with Civil Environmental Survey Group Inc. Approve amendment 5 to contract MA-063-22010549 with Omni Enterprise, Inc. for janitorial and day porter services at Social Services Agency facility located at 2020 West Walnut Street, Santa Ana, 9/1/26 - 8/31/27 ($290,891; cumulative total $1,482,015); approve amendment 4 to contract MA-063-22010568 with Omni Enterprise, Inc. for janitorial day porter services at Social Services Agency facility located at 15405 Lansdowne Road, Tustin, 9/1/26 - 8/31/27 ($268,274; cumulative total $944,884); and authorize County Procurement Officer or Deputized designee to execute amendments
